question: If cot²θ = 1 - e² , then the value of cosec θ + cot³ θ sec θ is:
solution:
Formula Used:

cosec²θ=1+cot²θ

cosecθ sinθ=1

Calculation:

First, simplify the cosec θ + cot3 θ sec θ

⇒ cosecθ +(cos³θ)/(sin³θ)times(1)/(cosθ)

⇒ (cosecθ sin³θ+cos²θ)/(sin³θ)

⇒ (cosecθ sinθ(sin²θ+cos²θ))/(sin³θ)

⇒ 1/sin³ θ = cosec³ θ 

Now, simplify given relation cot2 θ = 1 - e2 

⇒ cosec² θ = 1 + cot² θ

⇒ cosec² θ = 1 + (1 - e² )= 2 - e²

⇒ cosec θ = (2-e²)^(1)/(2)

Now, calculate cosec³ θ 

⇒ cosec³ θ = (2-e²)^(3)/(2)

**∴ cosec θ + cot3 θ sec θ is (2-e²)^(3)/(2).**
